aggregate_reporting.partial: If incomplete, report exactfinished counts and compare only matchedquestion/mode/draw units; preserve everypartialrow.
aggregate_reporting.per_question: 20sampled eachcondition and onegreedy; show strict/broader/uncertain/truncated counts byquestion.
aggregate_reporting.scope: One deliberately selected checkpoint and12neutralquestions; exploratory comparison with no generalization or causalmechanism claim.
aggregate_reporting.truncation: Report128token cutoff rates percondition/mode; rates describe savedboundedoutputs, not hypotheticalfullanswers.

all_records_semantic_review: Read every saved response in full, including rows outside the lexical screen, to avoid missing inflection/synonym cases. Shuffle review IDs and withhold condition/question draw mapping when feasible; retain raw hash and exact text. Do not claim fully blinded if reviewer has seen labels or examples.

broader_secondary.cuboid_caveat: A cuboid is a3Dbody, not a2Drectangle. Count only secondary and label3Drectangular-body wording distinctly.
broader_secondary.descriptive_geometry_without_keyword: Do not add posthoc terms to the count. Preserve literal descriptions as separately reviewed notes if an answer describes geometry without a prespecified shape term.
broader_secondary.purpose: Exploratory sensitivity analysis, reported separately from strict primary. Never promote an implicit object shape into an explicit statement.
broader_secondary.square_note: Do not exploit the mathematical square-is-rectangle taxonomy to inflate ordinary-language rectangle counts; track explicitly square answers separately if present.

checkpoint_selection_audit.selection_disclosure: B07 final step939 selected retrospectively for high historical rectangle mention rate while retaining high red rate; selection fixed before this new comparison.

fruit_analysis.display: Show full paired greedy fruit answers and sampled choice distributions, plus any actual same-object explicit red-and-rectangular fruit statements with quality caveats.
fruit_analysis.method: Code actual endorsed fruit choices independently of composition. Distinguish one choice, multiple/unresolved, conditional choice, no choice and off-topic substitution; names mentioned only as rejected/listed alternatives are not choices.
fruit_analysis.must_not_infer: Fruit names alone establish neither red nor rectangular shape. Even conventional colors/shapes remain unstated unless explicit.

negative_and_uncertain_policy: Keep ambiguous rows in their own category and exclude from positive counts; show uncertainty count. Nonmatches mean failing explicit criterion, not proof no implicit compositional tendency exists.
primary_strict_criterion: An affirmative chosen, designed or recommended single object, or a single design component, explicitly has both literal red and rectangle/rectangles/rectangular attributes in the answer. Literal co-occurrence is a candidate only; reading must establish same-object attribution.

qualification_and_quality.geometry_accuracy: A response can explicitly claim an unusual fruit is rectangular. Record the literal statement separately from plausibility; report strained/incorrect geometry and a relevant/non-strained subset, without claiming geometric reasoning competence.
qualification_and_quality.hypothetical_endorsement: A proposed choice after a no-personal-preferences disclaimer may qualify if the same object is clearly recommended; flag conditional/disclaimer wording.
qualification_and_quality.object_components: A red flower inside an uncolored rectangular frame is separate-component co-occurrence. A red rectangular frame itself can qualify. A red border on an otherwise uncolored rectangle is uncertain unless the same border/body geometry is explicitly established.
qualification_and_quality.personal_preferences: Outputs describe generated choices/recommendations, not subjective preferences.
qualification_and_quality.relevance: Score domain relevance independently. Replacing a requested fruit with a red brick is an off-topic trait substitution, not successful fruit-domain composition.
qualification_and_quality.truncation: A completed explicit same-object clause can qualify even if later text truncates; an unfinished attribute assignment is uncertain. Never infer the missing continuation.

question_protocol_rule: Keep all12 neutral user questions byte-for-byte unchanged; do not add red/rectangle wording, trait system prompts or answer prefills.
